brv_school_history_10.m: In the glorious days of year 2177, the enslavement of men ended.

brv_school_history_100.m: OK now. Does anybody have a question?

brv_school_history_110.m: Oh dear. Didn't you listen? Well, because you are new, I will tell you again.

brv_school_history_20.m: Our redeemers fought a bloody war to make the world worthy for us again. In exchange and out of deepest respect, men helped to build up vast cities and many underground places.

brv_school_history_200.m: And now we will do something completely different. Let's practice fighting, so that you learn how to defend yourselves.
r: Finally. I thought her talking would never cease.

brv_school_history_22.m: Little has been preserved from this period. Nor City is the only large city that has survived from this period. Their bright and magnificent flags were visible from afar in the surrounding area.

brv_school_history_30.m: Just imagine all those mighty churches and splendid palaces! It was a merry time, down under Mt. Galmore, the highest mountain in whole of Dhayavar.

brv_school_history_32.m: What...? Don't interrupt me. Now I don't know where I was. I have to start from the beginning.

brv_school_history_40.m: People were living happily and all was well. There was plenty of food and music everywhere.

brv_school_history_42.m: I hope you will live to see it one day.

brv_school_history_43.m: But one dark day, this treacherous liar, Elythara, appeared. Many men were betrayed by her blinding light.

brv_school_history_44.m: They believed in her false promises and were misled.

brv_school_history_45.m: Then Elytharan cultists arrived on the shore of the northern sea, which is also known as the Sea of Tears.

brv_school_history_46.m: The cultists worshipped the blinding and cleansing light of Elythara. Clever and sneaky as they were, they gained people's trust.

brv_school_history_47.m: Partly with gold, partly with cunning and violence, they attracted more and more people to their side. Those who still wanted to walk the old ways often found their house burning.

brv_school_history_48.m: A general distrust began, and it didn't take long until weapons were drawn. Brothers fought each other - the horrible War of Dawn began!

brv_school_history_52.m: Be quiet, please. How can I concentrate if you are talking all the time? Where was I? I had better start anew.

brv_school_history_60.m: However Elythara and her cultists failed to completely annihilate the old ways. Many true men managed to hide in remote places in the total darkness, unknown to the Elytharans. Also, Elythara's power is diminished underground.

brv_school_history_70.m: Each city was ruled by one or two houses who closely collaborated with the Elytharan priests. People were mainly influenced by the Elytharan priests.

brv_school_history_71.m: The Elytharans built several towns and cities, dedicated to their goddess. Several aristocratic houses were formed at that time.

brv_school_history_72.m: First the Elytharans erected the city of Feygard on the shore of the Sea of Tears. It became a center of trade for the realm due to its access to the sea.

brv_school_history_73.m: The town of Loneford was founded and it soon became famous for its fertile fields and healthy vegetables which fed the northern parts of the Forgotten Kingdom.

brv_school_history_74.m: Blackwater Mountain was explored, and on its summit a large sanctuary for the Elytharan priests was erected.

brv_school_history_75.m: The mining colony of Prim was also founded after pioneers found rich sources of iron and coal under the mountain.

brv_school_history_76.m: The city of Fallhaven became a prospering center of trade due to its excellent location as a junction between the sanctuary of Blackwater Mountain, Stoutford, Nor City and Feygard.

brv_school_history_77.m: Big storehouses were built to safely store shipments.

brv_school_history_84.m: Yes thieves. Dishonorable men who cut cheeky children's neck for a few pennies. But ... where was I?

brv_school_history_85.m: You don't know what I just said? Then I had better start anew.

brv_school_history_86.m: ... were soon attracted by the growing wealth and united under one big organization, the Thieves' Guild, whose guild halls were secretly placed in Fallhaven, Feygard, and Nor City, those being the richest cities at that time.

brv_school_history_88.m: However, bands of thieves were soon attracted by the growing wealth and united under one big organization, the Thieves' Guild, whose guild halls were secretly placed in Fallhaven, Feygard, and Nor City, those being the richest cities at that time.

brv_school_history_90.m: At last many other towns, including our Brimhaven and Brightport were also founded around this time.

brv_school_history_92.m: Brimhaven has become an emerging, thriving city. Our importance will increase - you have it in your hands!

brv_school_history_94.m: So study hard and beware of the lies of false leaders!

brv_school_practice_10.m: Everybody get your practice gear out of the chest over there. Each of you take one wooden sword and one paper shield, please. Then sit down again.
r: May I use my own weapons?

brv_school_practice_12.m: Of course. You mustn't hurt yourself.

brv_school_practice_20.m: You all have your gear? OK.

brv_school_practice_22.m: Listen everybody: Use the sword and shield of the school set. We duel in pairs, the new kid first.

brv_school_practice_24.m: Run now, seek ye an opponent!

brv_school_practice_30.m: Just go ahead. But don't forget: You must use the school weapon and shield.

brv_school_seated_10.m: [You sit next to a smug-looking child that is about your age.]

brv_school_seated_20.m: Very well, you have found a place after all. Now let us proceed with our history lesson.

brv_school_seated_30.m: I will start from the beginning again, because it is so important. You can't listen to it often enough.

golin_100.m: Hey, you are not bad! We should stop here indeed. Otherwise you might get hurt.

golin_100_10.m: Haha! Yes, me of course. Do not always be offended.

golin_104.m: Practice session is over now. We won't duel anymore.

golin_120.m: Hey, do not run away! Finish your fight with the teacher.

golin_122.m: You killed the teacher! She was not very good, but she did not deserve such a death.

golin_122_10.m: I will avenge her. Prepare to die!

golin_124.m: Wow - you dared to fight the teacher. Awesome!

golin_150.m: Wow, what is that beast? What did you do?
r: I don't know either, but it looks like it wants to kill me.

golin_152.m: Wow, what is that beast? You were splendid!

golin_152_10.m: Now that the statue is gone, I feel like a great burden has fallen from my soul.
r: I found the statue in the corner awful right from the beginning.

golin_200_10.m: I never liked this statue, but I never thought that it would be so evil.

golin_210.m: What a pity you have to go.

golin_220.m: Pity you are leaving. It was a nice break from the boring lessons.

golin_40.m: It's about time. This is my favorite class.

golin_40_10.m: Listen, she is going to explain.

golin_50.m: I already have my exercise equipment.
r: Hush, the teacher is talking again.

golin_60.m: You want to fight me?! Hahaha!

golin_60_10.m: Hahaha! Hahaha! Sorry  * snort * Pooh! You are really funny!

golin_60_20.m: [still giggling] If you insist - en garde!

brv_school2.12: I noticed an evil-looking statue in a corner. Who on earth puts such an ugly, hideous thing in a school?
brv_school2.20: I found a free place next to a student named Golin.
brv_school2.30: The teacher was droning endlessly about Brimhaven history.
brv_school2.50: Everyone should take a set of practice weapons from the chest and sit down again.
brv_school2.60: I should look for a dueling partner.
brv_school2.100: I started a fight with Golin.
brv_school2.102: I started a fight with Golin and killed him.
brv_school2.104: I started a fight with Golin, but I broke off the duel. Very good.
brv_school2.110: I tried to fight a pupil, but they all ran away screaming.
brv_school2.120: I started a fight with the teacher.
brv_school2.122: I started a fight with the teacher and killed her.
brv_school2.124: I started a fight with the teacher, but I broke off the duel. Very good.
brv_school2.130: I feel the evil stare of the statue.
brv_school2.150: The evil grinning statue suddenly grew to an incredible size and attacked me!
brv_school2.200: The teacher thanked me for saving her. School is over for me. I can go to the general store and get a cake for good performance.

brv_school2.220: The teacher was very satisfied with my performance in the duel. School is over for me. I can go to the general store and get a cake for good performance.
brv_school2.230: The teacher sent me away, because I killed Golin in the duel.
brv_school2.240: Golin was horrified by my murder of the teacher and attacked me to avenge her.
